title: Createcraft: A New Era
description: A Create 6 modpack with trains, nukes & factories.
body:
# CreateCraft 🔧

A fabric-based modpack built around **Create 6**, packed with addons that push the mod to its limits.

Build intricate factories, engineer massive railway networks with **Steam 'n' Rails**, go nuclear with **Create Nuclear**, or set up automated economies using **Create: Numismatics**. Whether you want to decorate your builds with **Create Deco** and **Create: Interiors**, copy structures with **Create: Copycats+**, or craft enchantments industrially with **Create Enchantment Industry** — this pack has it all.

## Features
- Fully built around **Create 6** and its ecosystem
- Optimized with Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore for smooth performance
- Iris shaders support out of the box
- Simple Voice Chat included for multiplayer
- Clean HUD with Jade, AppleSkin, and Xaero's Minimap & World Map

## Included Create Addons
- Create: Steam 'n' Rails
- Create Nuclear
- Create Crafts & Additions
- Create Deco
- Create: Interiors
- Create: Copycats+
- Create: Numismatics
- Create: Bells & Whistles
- Create Enchantment Industry
- Create Railways Navigator

## Installation
1. Download and install the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)
2. Import the `.mrpack` file
3. Hit play

## Server
This modpack has a companion server-side mod available for the best multiplayer experience.
Check it out here: [Createcraft: Server-Side Modpack](https://modrinth.com/project/createcraft-server-side-modpack)
